shellCommands.command: ls -la /workspace
find app lib -type f | head -50 && cat package.json
cat app/page.tsx app/layout.tsx "app/projects/[slug]/page.tsx" lib/data.ts next.config.ts
cat node_modules/next/package.json | head -5; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head
grep -ril "instant" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app | head
find node_modules/next/dist/docs -iname "*instant*" -o -iname "*prefetch*" | grep -v route-segment

ls __agent_eval__; grep -n "unstable_navigation" node_modules/next/dist/server/use-cache/*.d.ts node_modules/next/cache.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rn "instant\|prefetch" __agent_eval__ 2>/dev/null | head
grep -n "partialPrefetching" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts | head; grep -n "prefetch?" node_modules/next/dist/client/link.d.ts | head
sed -n 1680,1710p node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts

awk 'NR<=1703 && /^(interface|declare interface|type) /{line=NR": "$0} END{}' node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts; grep -n "interface ExperimentalConfig\|interface NextConfig " node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts | head
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -40
(npm start > /tmp/next-start.log 2>&1 &) && sleep 4 && curl -s localhost:3000/projects/acme | head -c 1200; echo; echo ---; curl -s localhost:3000/ | head -c 800

echo '== PREFETCH (what Link downloads before click) =='; time curl -s -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' 'localhost:3000/projects/acme' | grep -o "Acme Storefront\|Commerce storefront and checkout\|Production deployment" | sort | uniq -c; echo '== NAVIGATION (fetched on click) =='; time curl -s -H 'RSC: 1' 'localhost:3000/projects/acme' | grep -o "Acme Storefront\|Commerce storefront and checkout\|Production deployment" | sort | uniq -c

curl -s -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' 'localhost:3000/projects/acme' -o /tmp/prefetch.rsc -w '%{http_code} %{time_total}\n'; wc -c /tmp/prefetch.rsc; head -c 600 /tmp/prefetch.rsc; echo; echo '====NAV===='; curl -s -H 'RSC: 1' 'localhost:3000/projects/acme' -o /tmp/nav.rsc -w '%{http_code} %{time_total}\n'; wc -c /tmp/nav.rsc; head -c 400 /tmp/nav.rsc

curl -sL -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' 'localhost:3000/projects/acme?_rsc=prefetch1' -o /tmp/prefetch.rsc -w '%{http_code} %{time_total}\n'; grep -c "Acme Storefront" /tmp/prefetch.rsc; grep -c "Commerce storefront" /tmp/prefetch.rsc; echo '====NAV===='; curl -sL -H 'RSC: 1' 'localhost:3000/projects/acme?_rsc=nav1' -o /tmp/nav.rsc -w '%{http_code} %{time_total}\n'; grep -c "Acme Storefront" /tmp/nav.rsc; grep -c "Commerce storefront" /tmp/nav.rsc
curl -s -o /dev/null -D - -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' 'localhost:3000/projects/acme' | grep -i location;

time curl -s -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' 'localhost:3000/projects/acme?_rsc=HEAvJdHAQJrUAe2K' -o /tmp/prefetch.rsc -w '%{http_code}\n'; grep -c "Acme Storefront" /tmp/prefetch.rsc; grep -c "Commerce storefront" /tmp/prefetch.rsc; head -c 500 /tmp/prefetch.rsc
head -c 2000 /tmp/nav.rsc

find .next/server -path '*projects*' -maxdepth 4 | head; echo ---; for f in $(find .next/server -path '*projects*' -name '*.rsc' -o -path '*projects*' -name '*.htm' | head -4); do echo "== $f"; grep -c "Acme Storefront\|Unknown project\|Commerce storefront\|Loading project" "$f" 2>/dev/null; done
pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null; git diff --stat; git status --short
git status --short; git log --oneline | head -3; git diff HEAD --stat
git diff package.json tsconfig.json
